display.title: Blank Map Promise
display.description: Help a cartographer prepare the paper, compass, and ink needed for a long atlas.

tracker.text: Bring 24 paper for the atlas folio.
Bring 1 compass for the first bearing.
tracker.complete_text: The compass is set beside the maps.

tracker.text: Bring 3 ink sacs for clean labels.
tracker.complete_text: The ink is dark enough for road names.

proof.text: Bring paper, a compass, and ink to the cartographer.

return.text: Return to the cartographer with the atlas supplies.

start: Bring paper, a compass, and ink. If the atlas begins clean, the roads may stay honest.
reminder: The atlas still needs paper, one compass, and ink. Every great map starts as a fussy shopping list.
turn_in: Good. Blank pages, true needle, black ink. Now we can ask the world where it has been hiding.
already_completed: The atlas has its first pages.
unavailable: I am not ready to begin that atlas with you yet.
inactive: The atlas desk is closed for now.
missing_target: The atlas supplies are still short.
missing_proof: Bring the full set of supplies before I bind the first folio.
locate_failed: The map table is not ready today.
